t: Bitcoin Taker Buy Ratio Signals Peak Bearish Sentiment — Relief Soon?
s: 5 days ago - The Bitcoin Taker Buy Ratio is a sentiment indicator that estimates the proportion of trading volume owned by buyers against that of the sellers. Typically, values below 1 signal that taker sell volumes (aggressive selling) are outpacing taker buy volumes, which implies that sellers are overwhelming the buyers in the market.
